sentences.text:
This is an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. praying for anticipatory bail to the petitioner,
Rahim Khan.
The petitioner is charge-sheeted as accused in PRC case No. 185/2023 arising out of Sapekhati PS case No. 16/2023 under Section 376 IPC.
After investigation, the Investigating Authority filed charge- sheet under Section 376 IPC.

Referring to the charge-sheet, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that admittedly the allegation the petitioner is rape in the pretext of promise to marry her and the petitioner was shown to be absconder in the charge-sheet.

The learned counsel for the petitioner referring to an order of this court dated 22.05.2023 submits that there is a love affair between the petitioner and the informant and accordingly, due to misunderstanding FIR was lodged.
However, during the proceeding of AB 1243/2023 a compromise was entered between both the accused and informant.
According, the aforesaid bail application was withdrawn.

The learned counsel for the petitioner further referred to the settlement between the petitioner and the informant wherein it has been declared that there was misunderstanding and parties have amicable settled the matter.
Be that as it may
, for proper appreciation, the statement of the victim girl recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and 161 Cr.P.C. shall be necessary.

In that view of the matter the Registry to call for the scanned copy of the proceeding as well as scanned copy of the case diary of Sapekhati PS case No.
16/2023 under Section 376 IPC from the court of learned SDJM (M), Charaideo, Sonari.

Till such scanned copies are received, considering the matter in its entirety Page No.# 3/3 and also considering the age of the victim and her statement in the alleged deed of agreement, this court is of the view that the petitioner is entitled for interim protection till the scanned copies are received.

Accordingly, the applicant above named shall be allowed to go on pre-arrest bail on furnishing a bond of Rs. 20,000/- with one local surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
List after four weeks for production of the scanned copies.
